summary: LTC Properties filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $500 million of common stock, replacing a prior $400 million ATM that had ~$88.6 million unsold. The program includes forward sale agreements where agents borrow and sell shares, with proceeds deferred until physical settlement. Proceeds may be used for general corporate purposes including acquisitions and debt repayment, but the filing does not specify use. Agents include Citizens JMP, KeyBanc, Wells Fargo, and others. No board recommendation or advisors named. What to watch: potential dilution vs. capital deployment for acquisitions.
